<!--
MDVu One Screen — a compact presentation, not an exhaustive conformance suite.
Open in Obsidian dialect for live wikilinks and the image embed. Keep this filename.
Run: mdvu --dialect obsidian --full-width --theme light MDVu-One-Screen.md
Target: one landscape viewport about 1900 x 850 CSS pixels; responsive at larger sizes.
The self-contained CSS data URL sets layout only. All math and diagrams are source.
A stylesheet link is used because cmark-gfm's tagfilter escapes raw style elements.
The embedded image is the MDVu application icon from the supplied application build.
Runtime properties such as disk-cache persistence are not proven by a screenshot.
-->

<section class="card row1 essentials">
<a id="markdown"></a>
<span class="eyebrow">01 / CommonMark · GitHub GFM</span>

## The everyday essentials

**Bold** · *italic* · ***both*** · ~~old~~ · `code()`

| Feature | Example | Value |
|:--|:--:|--:|
| Aligned table | **GFM** | 42 |
| Inline math | $\sum_{k=1}^{n} k$ | $\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$ |

- [x] Tables, links & tasks
  - Nested structure, intact.
- [ ] Review the next release

> Portable source. Beautiful output.

</section>

## Mathematics, not screenshots

Euler, inline: $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$.

$$
\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} \exp(-x^2)\,dx = \sqrt{\pi}
$$

```math
\begin{pmatrix}1 & 2\\3 & 4\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}x+2y\\3x+4y\end{pmatrix}
```

$$
f(x)=\begin{cases}x^2 & x\ge 0\\-x & x<0\end{cases}
$$

```swift

let page = Page(title: "Hello, Markdown")
if !page.title.isEmpty {
    print(page.title) // Stay native.
}
```

<section class="card span2 architecture">
<a id="diagram-pipeline"></a>
<span class="eyebrow">05 / Mermaid · flowchart · groups · shapes · labels</span>

## From plain text to a complete document

```mermaid
%%{init: {"flowchart":{"nodeSpacing":12,"rankSpacing":24,"padding":8,"subGraphTitleMargin":{"top":3,"bottom":16}},"themeVariables":{"fontSize":"20px"}}}%%
flowchart LR
    A([Markdown]) --> B[cmark-gfm]
    B --> C{Content}
    subgraph Bundled[Local rendering]
      T[Text + tables]
      K[KaTeX → MathML]
      D[Mermaid + ZenUML + PlantUML]
    end
    C --> T
    C --> K
    C --> D
    T --> V([WebKit])
    K --> V
    D --> V
    classDef blue fill:#eaf1ff,stroke:#5980d2,color:#183b79
    classDef teal fill:#e6f5f0,stroke:#389883,color:#18584a
    classDef amber fill:#fff4db,stroke:#caa34f,color:#75591e
    class A,B,T,K blue
    class D,V teal
    class C amber
```

<p class="diagram-caption">Live diagram-as-code: linked nodes, a decision, a subgraph and styled classes.</p>

</section>

<section class="card">
<a id="sequence"></a>
<span class="eyebrow">06 / Mermaid · sequence · messages</span>

## Every interaction tells a story

```mermaid
%%{init: {"sequence":{"diagramMarginX":8,"diagramMarginY":18,"actorMargin":22,"width":95,"height":32,"boxMargin":3,"noteMargin":4,"messageMargin":23,"mirrorActors":false,"actorFontSize":16,"messageFontSize":15}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Reader
    participant MDVu
    participant Engine
    Reader->>MDVu: Open .md
    MDVu->>Engine: Render locally

    MDVu-->>Reader: Ready to explore
```

<section class="card">
<a id="plantuml"></a>
<span class="eyebrow">07 / PlantUML · components · Viz.js layout</span>

## Architecture without a server

```plantuml
@startuml
skinparam backgroundColor transparent
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam componentStyle rectangle
skinparam PackageBorderColor #7D8FA8
skinparam PackageFontColor #6E819C
skinparam defaultFontName Helvetica
skinparam defaultFontSize 15
skinparam ArrowColor #6E819C
skinparam ArrowFontColor #6E819C
skinparam roundcorner 10
left to right direction
package "Native application" {
  [Document] as D #EAF1FF
  [Renderer] as R #E6F5F0
  database "Disk cache" as C #FFF4DB
  D --> R : source
  R --> C : SHA-256
}
[WebKit] as W #F0ECFC
R --> W : SVG / MathML
@enduml
```

<p class="diagram-caption">Packages · components · database · directed dependencies</p>

</section>

<section class="card compact-diagram">
<a id="models"></a>
<span class="eyebrow">10 / PlantUML · class model · cardinality</span>

## Model the relationships

```plantuml
@startuml
skinparam backgroundColor transparent
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Helvetica
skinparam defaultFontSize 15
skinparam ArrowColor #6E819C
skinparam ArrowFontColor #6E819C
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
hide empty methods
left to right direction
class Document #EAF1FF {
  +title: String
  +render()
}
abstract class Block #E6F5F0 {
  +source: String
}
class Math #FFF4DB
class Diagram #F0ECFC
Document *-- "1..*" Block
Block <|-- Math
Block <|-- Diagram
@enduml
```

<p class="diagram-caption">Types · fields · composition · inheritance</p>

</section>
